title: What Makes a Good Fiqh Retriever? Answer Retrieval for Arabic Islamic Jurisprudence
abstract: arXiv:2608.20246v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation is used for Islamic question answering, but most systems are evaluated end-to-end, making retrieval failures difficult to isolate from generation failures. We study answer-bearing retrieval for Arabic fiqh, where a passage is relevant only if it states the ruling required by the question. We build a retrieval test collection for Arabic fiqh and use it to evaluate dense, lexical, hybrid, fine-tuned, and madhhab-aware retrieval strategies. The best retriever achieves 0.524 MRR@5, while fine-tuning improves performance to 0.553. Hybrid retrieval provides limited gains for strong models, whereas madhhab-aware filtering more than doubles MRR@5 on school-specific questions. We further present an error analysis showing that the main challenge is distinguishing answer-bearing passages from topically similar passages that do not contain the requested ruling.

translated_title: 什么造就了好的伊斯兰教法检索器？阿拉伯伊斯兰法学的答案检索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20246v1 公告类型：新  摘要：检索增强生成被用于伊斯兰问题解答，但大多数系统是端到端评估的，这使得检索失败难以与生成失败区分开来。我们研究了阿拉伯伊斯兰法学（fiqh）中的答案承载检索，其中段落只有在陈述问题所要求的裁决时才相关。我们为阿拉伯伊斯兰法学构建了一个检索测试集合，并用于评估密集、词汇、混合、微调以及教法学派感知的检索策略。最佳检索器实现了0.524的MRR@5，而微调将性能提升至0.553。混合检索对强模型提供的增益有限，而教法学派感知过滤在特定学派问题上使MRR@5提高了两倍以上。我们进一步进行了错误分析，表明主要挑战在于区分承载答案的段落与主题相似但不包含所要求裁决的段落。
tldr: 本文首次系统研究阿拉伯伊斯兰法学中的答案承载检索，发现教法学派感知过滤能显著提升检索性能，而主要挑战在于区分答案段落与主题相似的非答案段落。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies answer-bearing retrieval for Arabic fiqh, finding that madhhab-aware filtering significantly boosts retrieval performance, while the main challenge lies in distinguishing answer-bearing passages from topically similar non-answer passages.
